name: IKEA LILLABO to BRIO train track connector

captions.detailed: This 3D model is a dumbbell-shaped adapter designed to connect toy train tracks. It features two upright cylindrical ends of slightly different diameters connected by a straight, rectangular central bridge. One of the cylindrical ends has four small, vertical ridge-like nodules distributed symmetrically around its outer surface to provide a snug friction fit, while the other end is smooth.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric connector for wooden train tracks that bridges two cylindrical ends of adjustable diameters with a rectangular bar of customizable length and thickness. One of the cylindrical ends must include four small vertical grip nodules spaced evenly around its circumference, with adjustable nodule radius and recession depth.
captions.factory: The script defines the model using basic primitives. It creates the primary fixed end cylinder at the origin and translates a second male end cylinder along the X-axis by 'stud_length'. A rectangular 'cube' is translated and sized to form the connecting bridge between the two cylinders. Finally, four small vertical cylinders representing the grip nodules are placed on the perimeter of the first cylinder using trigonometric translations (sin and cos) based on 'nodangle' and 'nod_recess'.
